Youth Soccer

The YMCA Youth Soccer program introduces players to the world’s game while emphasizing skill development, teamwork, sportsmanship, and fun. Children of all skill levels and abilities are encouraged to participate, from first-time players to those with previous soccer experience.

We offer 2 soccer seasons, one in fall and one in spring. Participants must be 3 years old by the first practice date of each season. Each season consists of 6 Saturdays where the players will learn the basics of soccer through fun games and activities. On the last Saturday of each season, we will scrimmage to end the season.

Our youth sports programs depend on volunteers who have a heart to see kids learn, grow, and have fun. Does this sound like you? Complete a volunteer application here: https://bit.ly/4wSbKHY
